title: Apple Stock (AAPL) Falls 1.9% on Gross Margin Guidance (Nov 3)
summary: AAPL fell 1.90% to $331.90 on Nov 3 after Apple guided December-quarter gross margin to 45% to 46%, below analyst estimates.
body_markdown:
## Why Apple Stock Fell


Apple released its fiscal fourth-quarter[earnings report](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/learn/how-to-read-an-earnings-report/) after the close on Monday, November 2, as reported by[24/7 Wall St.](https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/11/03/apple-retreats-4-despite-earnings-beat-as-memory-costs-squeeze-margin-outlook-microsoft-dips-meta-holds-steady/) . According to the company's[official earnings release](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000320193/000032019326000024/a8-kex991q4202609262026.htm) , revenue for the quarter ended September 26 rose 12% from a year earlier to a September-quarter record of $114.5 billion, and diluted earnings per share climbed 14% to $2.10. Gross margin was 47.9%, including a favorable impact of about 1 percentage point from tariff refunds.


The outlook weighed more than the beat. Per[24/7 Wall St.](https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/11/03/apple-retreats-4-despite-earnings-beat-as-memory-costs-squeeze-margin-outlook-microsoft-dips-meta-holds-steady/) , Apple guided December-quarter gross margin to a range of 45% to 46%, below a 46.3% analyst estimate, while projecting total revenue growth of 7% to 10%. CEO John Ternus called memory pricing "unprecedented," and CFO Kevan Parekh attributed most of the expected margin decline to higher memory costs, along with Siri AI cloud expenses and hardware revenue deferrals.


Financial media tied the session's drop to that guidance.[Barron's](https://finance.yahoo.com/m/128f1048-6ad1-33df-9ddf-897d7e346cbb/apple%2C-palantir%2C-pfizer%2C.html) wrote that Apple fell after the iPhone maker's guidance failed to meet investors' high bar, while[Stocktwits](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/p-500-nasdaq-recover-ai-232955884.html) reported that the company's quarterly margins and sales figures failed to impress investors.


## AAPL Stock Analysis: Supporting Factors and Risks


### Supporting Factors


- Record quarter: Apple's[release](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000320193/000032019326000024/a8-kex991q4202609262026.htm) reported September-quarter records for revenue, net income and earnings per share, with revenue up 12% to $114.5 billion.
- iPhone strength: iPhone revenue reached $57.58 billion, ahead of a $56.48 billion estimate, according to[24/7 Wall St.](https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/11/03/apple-retreats-4-despite-earnings-beat-as-memory-costs-squeeze-margin-outlook-microsoft-dips-meta-holds-steady/)
- Holiday quarter growth: Apple projected December-quarter revenue growth of 7% to 10%, per the same report.


### Risks


- Memory costs: Ternus said Apple expects memory purchase pricing to keep rising beyond the December quarter, and management expects memory to limit Mac and iPad supply in the December quarter, according to 24/7 Wall St.
- Softer spots: Greater China revenue of $17.54 billion trailed an $18.75 billion estimate, and Services growth guidance of 8% to 9% sat below a 10.7% expectation, per 24/7 Wall St.
- Margin base: the 47.9% September-quarter gross margin included about 1 percentage point from tariff refunds, according to Apple's release.


Apple also declared a cash dividend of $0.27 per share, payable on November 16, 2026, to shareholders of record as of November 12, according to the company's release.
